column1: # mirabel1622 key CLE_M02, CC BY 4.0 (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffrée, 2026). The Mirabel/Feria cipher of 1622 (same system as coloma1622).
# CLE_M02 = coloma1622 key C04 (frozen 5 Nov 2026, SHA-256 714f70ba...) + values read on the contemporary clears of BNE MSS/18428
# (the two bound clear copies fol. 31 = image 32 right and images 39 right - 40 left, the clear copy image 33 left of image 34 right,
# the margin clears of images 5 right - 7 right and 44 right). Nothing in it comes from the letter of images 13-15.
# Frozen by SHA-256 cf863ec2... (14 Nov 2026) before its one measurement (M02). NOT validated: M01 failed, M02 partial (validation.txt).
# UPPER CASE = code word (whole word or stem); empty value = null; source = where the value is held (C04 = coloma1622 key.tsv,
# itself rebuilt from the margin clears of the Duke of Feria's letters to Coloma, some values by sense).
# Added to C04 from contemporary clears: ō = t (o with a cross; distinct from Ð = n), 308 = NUESTRO, _0_ = REBELDE (C04: REVES), and the rows sourced below.
# Doubtful: g = p (clear copy v39 d: "protestantes", "procuro") against g = f (clear copy v33 g: "ofrecido"); g does not occur in this letter.
# sa = al is the reading already integrated in coloma1622 (PRs #417, #543). The frozen CLE_M02 had Ð = t because part B noted the ō as Ð (re-read 14 Nov).
# Not in the key (no value): 24, 48~, 87, 9, 322, md, zan, fizt, xix, c̣ir, f‡an, g‡, p‡, D‡, x‡, f‡, su, _1_, _13_, _41_, 20~.
